response.text:
Issues found:

1. The opening hours note repeats the same sentence twice: once as the hours component's built-in note and once in the section's note prop. The hours already come from the business facts, which include this note.
2. The homepage shows contact facts in two places, the opening-hours section and the contact call-out, which also lists hours and address. The rules allow only one place near the top, and the contact section is also unnecessary when the site has no contact page. The call-out is the closing section for a phone-based shop, so I keep it. The opening-hours section is the duplicate, so I remove it.
3. The gallery repeats photos already shown above. After the opening-hours section is removed, img_01 and img_02 appear only in the gallery, which fixes this.
4. The price-list intro repeats the hero intro word for word ("Prodajamo samo izdelke manjših pridelovalcev…"). It should say something different, so I shorten it to what the prices cover.
5. The call-out contact section shows the address and hours twice on mobile, once in the call-out block and once in the footer. That comes from the component, so I leave it.

The remaining issues, the fixed header overlapping the hero and the lighthouse score, are outside spec patches.

Removing the opening-hours section removes the duplicated hours and the repeated note. The hours stay in the call-out contact and the footer.

```json
{"issues":["Opening hours note is shown twice (component note and facts note), and hours are repeated in the contact call-out","Price list intro repeats the hero intro word for word"],"patches":[{"op":"remove","path":"/pages/0/sections/1"},{"op":"replace","path":"/pages/0/sections/2/props/intro","value":"Nekaj cen iz naše ponudbe. Darilni paketi se začnejo pri 25 evrih."}]}
```

Note: after the removal the price-list section is at index 2 (hero, gifts, prices), so the second patch targets the right section.
